actions.name: upload-file
actions.description: Uploads a file to a Storage bucket.

actions.name: create_row
actions.description: Create a new row in a table

actions.name: update_row
actions.description: Update rows in a table based on filter criteria

actions.name: upsert_row
actions.description: Insert or update a row in a table

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.description: Remove rows matching filter criteria from a table

actions.name: search_rows
actions.description: Search for rows in a table with filters and pagination

actions.name: list_tables
actions.description: Returns a list of all public tables and views in the database

actions.name: get_table_schema
actions.description: Returns the column definitions for a specific table

actions.name: create_bucket
actions.description: Creates a new Storage bucket, public or private.

actions.name: delete_bucket
actions.description: Permanently deletes a Storage bucket. The bucket must be empty first.

actions.name: list_buckets
actions.description: Lists all Storage buckets in the project.

actions.name: list_files
actions.description: Lists files and folders inside a Storage bucket, optionally under a specific folder path.

actions.name: download_file
actions.description: Downloads a file from a Storage bucket and returns its content as base64.

actions.name: delete_file
actions.description: Permanently deletes one or more files from a Storage bucket.

actions.name: create_signed_url
actions.description: Generates a time-limited URL that grants temporary access to a file in a private Storage bucket.

actions.name: list_users
actions.description: Lists the users registered in the project's Auth system. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: get_user
actions.description: Gets a single user's Auth record by ID. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: create_user
actions.description: Creates a user in Supabase Auth. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: update_user
actions.description: Updates a user's email, phone, password, or metadata. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: delete_user
actions.description: Permanently deletes a user from the project's Auth system. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: invite_user
actions.description: Sends an invite email to a new user, who sets their own password when accepting. Requires the Service Role Key.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_row
triggers.description: Fires when a new row is created in a table
